description:
Amazon WorkSpaces plays nice with everyone. Access your personal Windows environment on Android, iOS, Fire, Mac, PC, Chromebook, and Linux devices.


- [Windows] Added a preview of the new, modernized Amazon WorkSpaces client experience. Administrators can use the Client Experience Policy to control which experience their users receive. If enabled, users will see the option to try the new experience in the top right of the classic client, and can switch back.
- [Windows] Added support for honoring printer preferences when printing from a DCV-based WorkSpaces session.
- [Windows] Fixed an issue that prevented the session from automatically reconnecting when the WorkSpace was temporarily unreachable.
- [Windows] Fixed an issue that prevented signing in when a saved username included a domain prefix.
- [Windows] Fixed an issue that prevented connecting to WorkSpaces Pools in certain scenarios.
- [Windows] Improved the stability of the client application when connected displays change rapidly, such as with docking and undocking.
- [Windows] Fixed an issue that caused a black border to appear on certain dialog panels.
- [Windows] Updated the Microsoft Teams client plugin used for Microsoft Teams optimization.
- [Windows] Updated the DCV SDK.
- [Windows] Additional bug fixes and enhancements.
